interface.description: Network interface to listen on. Corresponds to the -i command line parameter.

verbose.description: Verbose mode. Corresponds to the -v command line parameter. Prints PIDs of created threads.

connection_policies.description: List of connection policies to track. Corresponds to 'Connection Policy Entry' in the Options menu. Default is only Telnet, but this allows custom rules. Each item defines src/dst filters and ports.

reset_daemon_enabled.description: Whether to enable the Reset daemon thread by default. Daemons are stopped by default.

arp_daemon_enabled.description: Whether to enable the ARP spoof/relayer daemon thread by default. Daemons are stopped by default.

ack_storm_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for automatic connection reset after ACK storm detection in Simple Hijack. Corresponds to 'Reset ACK Storm Timeout' in Options.

simple_hijack_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for waiting for the next command in Simple Hijack. Corresponds to 'Simple Hijack Timeout For Next cmd' in Options.

arp_packets_count.description: Number of ARP request or reply packets sent when doing ARP spoofing. Corresponds to 'ARP Request/Reply Packets' in Options.

host_resolving.description: Enable deferred host resolving (IP to name). Corresponds to 'Host Resolving' in Options.

learn_mac_from_ip.description: Enable learning MAC addresses from all IP traffic, not just ARP. Corresponds to 'Learn MAC From IP Traffic' in Options.

verbose_logging.description: Enable verbose logging for dropped packets (fragments, malformed) and protocol counts. Corresponds to 'Verbose On/Off' in Options when running with -v.
